name: touch-s2h-talk-r150-up
description: #120 stretch 2 probe (owner hint: talk to a party member), generated by runner/test/unit/playthrough-scenarios.js from the touch layer; boots from touch-md1-1 (stretch 1's end, kept by touch-playthrough). Input: wait 30 frames; segment touch-2-stall; right 150 with Interact taps, then Interact taps while dragging up until window 1 opens (w1_open, 600 frames); Interact taps until it closes (w1_close, 1800); 60 still frames; drag up until the field ID leaves md1_1 (exit, 1800). A timeout stops the script. End checks: md1_2 (0x76). Metrics: w1_open, w1_close, exit, map_cur, n1 .. n4 (talk-rule distance signs at the end). Only signs, frame counts and small state values leave.
